title: The industry life cycle
caption: Industry sales rise, level off and fall. Growth attracts entrants, a shake-out removes weaker firms, maturity brings price competition, and decline leaves a few firms serving a niche.
alt: Curve of industry sales over time divided into introduction, growth, shake-out, maturity and decline, with the peak of sales in maturity.
description: Introduction: few firms and low sales.
Growth: sales rise quickly and new entrants arrive.
Shake-out: growth slows and weaker firms exit.
Maturity: sales at their highest, standardised products and price competition.
Decline: sales fall as substitutes take over.
